verdict.rationale: Milvus has an official MCP server: the first-party Milvus docs include a tutorial for setting up an MCP server so AI applications can run vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data in natural language. The probe confirms the server lives in the vendor's zilliztech GitHub org. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection, and detailed evidence of the tool list and client configuration and transport.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This tutorial walks you through setting up an MCP server for Milvus, allowing AI applications to perform vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data using natural language commands
